author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Turn three flat AI generations into one cinematic poster you can crop for print, social, and every layout in between, without starting over.

In this tutorial, you'll discover how to:

-Load your Firefly generations as fully editable Smart Object layers you can adjust anytime
-Compose the scene at poster scale, then extend the background with Generative Fill
-Apply Camera Raw color grading, Tilt-Shift blur, and Harmonize to make everything look shot in one frame

Perfect for movie posters, marketing campaigns, and client deliverables.
How do you turn AI generations into finished, editable art? Comment below and save this tutorial for your next design.

Contents of this video:
00:01 Intro and meet author Jesús Ramirez
00:40 Load Firefly generations as modular layers
03:09 Scale and extend the scene for every crop and format
05:25 Refine the scene for a cinematic finish
